Post a marketing post for awareness on LinkedIn, for example about something interesting h
appening at a conference. → Market the business on LinkedIn to get exposure that is far be
tter than Google Ads, Facebook or other channels deliver.

ness on LinkedIn, for example about something interesting happening at a conference.
